goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics.

layers.mechanism: Current owner checkpoints meaningful work and emits one next-generation event on dedicated PR lane before observed early-runtime boundary.
layers.gate: Provision a ChatGPT Work GitHub PR commit-update trigger, then pass state/EVENT_WORKER_PROBE.json.

layers.target_latency: <=5m schedule interval plus GitHub/Work delivery delay
layers.mechanism: Public-repo GitHub Actions checks durable liveness every 5 minutes and emits at most one PR-lane rescue commit only when the event ledger is ACTIVE, the program is nonterminal, owner progress is stale >=180s, and no generation is outstanding.
layers.gate: Remains intentionally inert until the event-worker write probe passes and ledger is promoted ACTIVE.

layers.mechanism: Existing canonical ChatGPT scheduled task rotates BYMINUTE across quarter phases.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
wake event alone never advances authority
no secrets in public event lane
quarter fallback remains enabled until faster layers prove safe

capability_evidence.plugin_permission_setting: GitHub plugin is configured Allow all actions.
capability_evidence.official_event_task_permission_rule: OpenAI documentation states connected-app permissions, workspace controls and approval requirements continue to apply to event-triggered Work tasks.
capability_evidence.interpretation: Write parity is now plausible rather than speculative because event tasks inherit existing app permissions, but permissions do not create unsupported actions. One live event-worker write/readback probe remains required.

current_blocker: The current automation/plugin tool surface cannot provision or edit a ChatGPT Work GitHub event trigger. This is a provisioning-surface limitation, not evidence that the event worker lacks write capability.
next_test: Once a Work GitHub PR commit-update trigger exists for draft PR #1, run EVENT-WORKER-WRITE-PROBE-001. On PASS, promote ledger ACTIVE and run three bounded generations; on FAIL, retain the guarded Actions producer inert and continue adapter search while quarter fallback remains active.
